negative_reviews.author: Jade Wong
negative_reviews.text: Food was okay, the sushi doesn’t feel fresh enough unfortunately, however the service and the chef were really kind and apologetic about the long wait for the food. The vibe of the restaurant is nice and not too loud. I ordered a chef selection of 15. I wouldn’t say it’s the traditional omakase as it came in a platter of plate but there was still introduction of what’s on the plate.
